title: Pro Evolution Soccer 2011 arrives on PlayStation 2

blocks.text: In 2010, Pro Evolution Soccer 2011 became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the sports category, Pro Evolution Soccer 2011 broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
